name: YMCA Summer Camp (Smithfield YMCA)
description_short: Summer camp run by the Smithfield YMCA in Greenville, RI. The page asks families to read the "Know Before You Go" packet before registering and offers a waitlist.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: Page has almost no camp details: no dates, prices, ages or season year. Only a waitlist link and a 'Know Before You Go' packet are shown.
The page links to a waitlist, so camp may be full or not yet open. It's not clear which season this is for.
Footer copyright says 2019. The page may be out of date.
